qualifier: nuclear beta-catenin-TCF target gene control and its repression
name: Beta-catenin-TCF transcriptional control in canonical Wnt signalling
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt output at the beta-catenin/TCF and destruction-complex level (TCF binding, transactivating complex deactivation, target repression, APC/AXIN1 defects), whereas the confusables centre on ligand secretion, FZD/LRP5/RNF43 receptor events and DVL activation.

qualifier: MHC class I/KIR recognition by NK cells
name: Cytotoxic lymphocyte killing regulated by MHC class I recognition
rationale: Members cover positive and negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, granzyme killing, KIR-cluster NK modules, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing, distinguishing it from confusables built on T cell activation/proliferation or dendritic cell tolerance.

qualifier: replication-blocking drugs and protein-DNA crosslinks
name: DNA replication and response to replication-blocking drugs
rationale: Members pair replication initiation and S-phase replication with responses to camptothecin, hydroxyurea and protein-DNA crosslink repair, whereas confusables emphasise DNA topology/fork reversal, telomere maintenance or checkpoint signalling.

qualifier: endocytic uptake, endosome tubulation and recycling
name: Endocytosis and endosomal recycling to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members centre on plasma membrane-endosome traffic (clathrin uncoating, endosome tubulation and organisation, receptor and endocytic recycling) with flippase/trafficking gene modules, whereas confusables are Golgi secretion and ARF/Rab GTPase regulation.

qualifier: hypusine, diphthamide and tRNA wybutosine of translation machinery
name: Rare amino acid modifications in proteins and translation machinery
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications (hydroxylation, oxidation, formylglycine, hypusine on eIF5A, diphthamide on EEF2, selenocysteine, tRNA wybutosine) often affecting translation, unlike confusables covering core translation, RNA modification or protein methylation.

qualifier: adrenaline/noradrenaline secretion feedback
name: Catecholamine secretion and adrenergic heart and blood-pressure control
rationale: Members link regulation of adrenaline/noradrenaline secretion to heart rate, contractile force and systemic blood pressure, whereas confusables are alpha-2/adenylate-cyclase-inhibitory receptor signalling or cardiac contraction without catecholamine secretion.

qualifier: ATF6/XBP1/CREB3 chaperone gene induction
name: ER unfolded protein response and chaperone gene induction
rationale: Members are ER-stress UPR arms (ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3, IRE1, ER-stress translation control, beta-cell apoptosis) with transcriptional chaperone activation, distinguishing it from confusables built on mitochondrial/HRI/GCN2 integrated stress or PERK inhibition.

qualifier: ABCA1-apoA-I lipid efflux
name: ABCA1-apoA-I lipid efflux and HDL particle assembly
rationale: Members cover nascent HDL assembly, phospholipid efflux, apoA-I signalling and ABCA1 transport/defect, whereas confusables cover HDL/LDL remodelling, HDL clearance or LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and foam cell regulation.

qualifier: with heterogeneous proliferation-linked housekeeping gene modules
name: Pre-rRNA processing with proliferation-linked housekeeping modules
rationale: About half the members are pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and ribosome assembly, the rest are loosely proliferation-linked gene modules (mitochondrial upkeep, RB1/BCL2L1, polycomb, ubiquitination, centrosome), lacking the RNA polymerase I/III transcription and MYC programmes of the confusables.

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodelling
name: Microglia-mediated synapse pruning and neuronal remodelling
rationale: Members combine microglial differentiation, proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity with synapse pruning, spine maintenance and neuron remodelling, whereas confusables emphasise apoptotic cell clearance, amyloid formation, astrocytes or reelin signalling.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte growth, hypertrophy and ventricular wall formation
name: Myocardial growth, hypertrophy and ventricular wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members centre on cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and regeneration, trabecular/compact myocardium and associated vascular smooth muscle, whereas confusables add septum, endocardium, valve and conduction-system development.

qualifier: testicular Sertoli and Leydig cells
name: Germ cell and testicular somatic cell development
rationale: Members cover germ cell migration, proliferation, meiotic entry and death alongside Sertoli, Leydig and seminiferous tubule development, distinguishing it from confusables on sperm assembly, ovarian/oocyte biology or sex determination.

qualifier: with loss of sister chromatid cohesion
name: Mitotic chromosome condensation and cohesion removal
rationale: Members are prophase/prometaphase and meiotic chromosome condensation with negative regulation of cohesion and chromatin protein localisation, whereas confusables centre on cohesin loading, cohesion establishment and CENP-A deposition.

qualifier: ureteric bud and nephric duct formation, kidney growth control
name: Ureteric bud formation and regulation of kidney growth
rationale: Members cover nephric duct and ureteric bud formation/branching with regulation of kidney size, proliferation, apoptosis and progenitor maintenance, whereas confusables add nephron tubule differentiation, renal vesicle and intermediate mesoderm.

qualifier: attenuation by RAS GAPs and negative feedback
name: RAS-ERK signalling with GAP and feedback attenuation
rationale: Members cover RAS/MAPK transmission (SOS, IRS/SHC, RSK, pathway mutants) together with its attenuation by RAS GAPs, NF1 loss, ERK inactivation and dephosphorylation, whereas confusables emphasise RAF activation or RTK/PI3K upstream signalling.

qualifier: TRKA (NGF) and TRKC (NTF3) cascades
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin receptor signalling cascades
rationale: Members are NGF-TRKA and NTF3-NTRK3 activation and their PI3K, PLCG1, RAS/ERK5, STAT3 and CREB outputs, distinguishing it from confusables on p75NTR, generic ERK5/MAPK or TRKB signalling.

qualifier: actin-based dendritic spine and filopodium remodelling
name: Actin-based dendritic spine and postsynaptic structure regulation
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organisation, filopodia, spine morphogenesis, synapse structural plasticity and receptor delivery, whereas confusables emphasise dendrite arborisation, EPHB signalling or NMDAR-RAC1 plasticity.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ mechanoresponse and growth factor production
name: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation and growth factor output
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal programmes (YAP/TAZ-CCN targets, fibroblast proliferation, PDGF response, SMAD2/3, FOSL1/2, KRAS-up) with VEGF/TGFB2 paracrine output, whereas confusables centre on PDGF receptor regulation, adhesion or ECM/EMT modules.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are RNA polymerase III initiation from type 1-3 promoters, elongation and termination plus tRNA and snRNA transcription, whereas confusables involve RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription, rRNA processing or translation.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to ERK
qualifier: ALK/LTK autophosphorylation
name: ALK/LTK receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK activation
rationale: Members are ALK/LTK (MDK, PTN) receptor signalling, tyrosine autophosphorylation and positive ERK regulation, whereas confusables emphasise PI3K/AKT or PDGF/stromal signalling.

qualifier: axon-glia node of Ranvier organisation
name: Myelination and axon-glia node of Ranvier organisation
rationale: Members combine CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell myelination with neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin and sodium channel clustering at nodes and paranodes, whereas confusables centre on axon regeneration or glial fate specification.

qualifier: store-operated calcium entry
name: Calcium sensing and store-operated calcium entry
rationale: Members concern detection of and response to calcium, store-operated and voltage-gated calcium channel activation, whereas confusables emphasise calcium extrusion, Na/Ca exchange or ryanodine-receptor release.

qualifier: of nuclear target proteins
name: SUMO conjugation to nuclear target proteins
rationale: Members are SUMOylation of substrate classes (nuclear envelope, chromatin, DNA repair/replication, RNA-binding, cofactor proteins) plus RanBP2-linked Ran mitosis, whereas confusables cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 conjugation steps and desumoylation.

qualifier: SLC26 exchangers and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters
name: SLC26 anion exchangers and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover SLC26 sulfate, iodide, oxalate and chloride exchange and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport with their channelopathies, whereas confusables centre on bicarbonate transporters, aquaporins or sodium/proton exchangers.

qualifier: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and downstream cascades
name: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and downstream signalling cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 ligand/Klotho binding, isoform splicing, point mutants and their FRS, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades with Sprouty feedback, whereas confusables centre on TKI-resistant kinase mutants and fusions or ERBB/MET signalling.
